content:
Grouping by ordering table and the BWXC (lower TX/RX upper) vs BXWC (upper TX/RX lower) pair. Global specs (FEC, standards, RX) apply to every SKU; `wavelength_center_nm` follows each ordering line (1282 nm / 1305 nm). BXXY/BXXy are family names with no separate ordering row—wavelengths match the lower/upper band roles in the narrative.

    },
